claim: SkillBridge caps Cat I 120 days, Cat II 90 days, Cat III 90 days (MARADMIN 280/24)

fix: NAVMC 1700.2B is newer than MARADMIN 280/24, 17 Jun 2024. It caps participation at 180 days and bars command rank restrictions. MARADMIN 280/24 said an order would codify its categories and NAVMC 1700.2B does not. Have HQMC confirm which governs before the page ships.

claim: Packages approved before 31 Aug 2024 are governed by NAVMC 1700.2B, later ones by the category framework
quote: NAVMC 1700.2B 04 Apr 2025
fix: Order of precedence is inverted. NAVMC 1700.2B post-dates the MARADMIN. Dated 4 Apr 2025.

claim: Cat I and II approval by LtCol and above, Cat III by General Officers
quote: SkillBridge requests are forwarded to, reviewed, and approved by the first commanding officer or officer in charge (OIC) with Uniform Code of Military Justice authority.
fix: Approval sits with the first CO or OIC with UCMJ authority, delegable to field grade CO or OICs with NJP authority. Same standard for officers and enlisted.

claim: NCMIS required, application up to 365 days from EAS
quote: SkillBridge participation is initiated by contacting the installation SkillBridge POC and completing a SkillBridge application.
fix: NAVMC 1700.2B names no NCMIS requirement or 365-day window. MARADMIN 280/24 para 4.c does.

claim: IDES Marines eligible only if separation within 180 days
quote: only authorize SkillBridge participation if they assess the Marine will separate within 180 days.
fix: Holds under MARADMIN 280/24 and matches NAVMC 1700.2B eligibility of separation within 180 days.

claim: SkillBridge reported on PTAD (Other) pending MCO 1050.3J updates
quote: Marines participating in SkillBridge will be accounted for in a S-PTAD status, however, the maximum PTAD limit of 30 days does not apply.
fix: Reporting code is S-PTAD, not PTAD, Other.

claim: DD Form 2648 validation period follows PAA 06-25
quote: If there is any uncertainty regarding the validity of a completed DD Form 2648, please reach out to the installation TRP manager
fix: PAA 06-25 sets TA and TZ code checks and no validation period. Filing is 12 months after EAS per MCO 1700.31A app A.

claim: Parole eligibility is 1/3 of sentence or 6 months, whichever is greater
quote: the prisoner must have served one third of the term of confinement, but in no case less than 6 months.
fix: Rule applies to unsuspended sentences of 12 months or more and under 30 years. 30 years to life needs 10 years served. Add both limits and drop typically.

claim: Matters submission to the convening authority runs under R.C.M. 1109
quote: the accused may submit matters to the convening authority under this rule within ten days after the sentence is announced.
fix: Matters by the accused sit in R.C.M. 1106, due within 10 days of announcement for GCM and SPCM and 7 days for SCM. R.C.M. 1109 is the convening authority's sentence reduction authority.

claim: Vacation of a suspended sentence runs under R.C.M. 1110
quote: Rule 1108. Vacation of suspension of sentence
fix: Vacation is R.C.M. 1108. R.C.M. 1110 is the convening authority action rule.

claim: Calendar the matters window at sentencing, no day count given
quote: After a trial by summary court-martial, the accused may submit matters under this rule within seven days
fix: Say 10 days for GCM and SPCM and 7 days for SCM. Page names no deadline and cites the wrong rule.

claim: Naval Consolidated Brigs at Chesapeake, Miramar and Charleston hold post-trial confinees
fix: MCO 1640.6 is not in the archive. Confirm the current facility list.

claim: Mandatory supervised release applies in post-2018 frameworks per DoDI 1325.07

fix: No mandatory supervised release rule located. Cite or remove.

claim: Parole routed to DON Clemency and Parole Board through Naval Consolidated Brig

claim: Neutral and detached officer reviews probable cause within 48 hours of pretrial confinement
quote: Review of the adequacy of probable cause to continue pretrial confinement shall be made by a neutral and detached officer within 48 hours of imposition
fix: The rule also requires the commander's 72-hour decision under R.C.M. 305, i, 2. Page omits it.

claim: Initial Review Officer hearing within 7 days
quote: Within 7 days of the imposition of confinement, a neutral and detached officer appointed in accordance with regulations prescribed by the Secretary concerned shall review

claim: Missing 48-hour review makes pretrial confinement unlawful and the confinee must be released
quote: The remedy for noncompliance with R.C.M. 305(g), (i), (j), or (k) shall be an administrative credit against the sentence adjudged
fix: Remedy is administrative sentence credit of 1 day per day of noncompliance. Release is not the stated remedy. Same for the 7-day pitfall.

claim: Additional day-for-day credit under R.C.M. 305(k) for defective confinement
quote: Such credit shall be computed at the rate of 1 day credit for each day of confinement served as a result of such noncompliance.
fix: Credit remedy now sits in R.C.M. 305, l. 305, k, is review by military judge. Update the cite on both lines.
